sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions take 1 tablet of this product and put it into 1000ml water, dissolve it completely, then spray it for disinfection
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings 1. This product is an external disinfectant and cannot be taken orally. 2. Keep out of reach of children. 3. This product has the bleaching effect and is not easy to be used for silk, wool, woolen fabric, easily faded fabric and leather products. Please be careful to use metal and paint to disinfect the surface. 4. When soaking white clothes, control the time at about 10 minutes. If the time is too long, the protective layer of white clothes may be damaged, resulting in yellow clothes. 5. Do not dilute effervescent tablets with hot water above 40 degrees.
